title: ShadeWalk: shade-facility extraction, facility-aware shadow modelling and coolest-route pedestrian flow mapping
description:
Code for ShadeWalk: city-scale mapping of artificial shade facilities (arcades / five-foot ways and covered linkways), facility-aware hourly shadow modelling with a modified SOLWEIG-GPU (LDSM and ADSM layers, 13-class shadow category), reconstruction of a shade-aware pedestrian network from OpenStreetMap, and coolest-route pedestrian-flow mapping for Singapore (Bologna as a second study city for the arcade detector).

The repository contains five modules: (1) SOLWEIG-GPU with LDSM/ADSM shadow layers, (2) covered-linkway extraction with GeoSAM + TopoLoRA including the annotated training dataset and the trained checkpoint, (3) arcade detection in street-view imagery with CLIP linear probes and projection onto building footprints, (4) pedestrian flow mapping (coolest-route cost model and madina patronage betweenness) with the ShadeWalk web tool, and (5) OSM pedestrian-network reconstruction with facility centrelines. Every module is documented with a README and a complete input-data inventory.
